words:
犯罪[はんざい] — crime — अपराध
犯人[はんにん] — culprit, offender — अपराधी
犯[おか]す — to commit (a crime, an error) — गर्नु (अपराध)
防犯[ぼうはん] — crime prevention — अपराध रोकथाम
example: 警察[けいさつ]は まだ 犯人[はんにん]を 捕[つか]まえていない。
example_en: The police haven't caught the culprit yet.
component: 犭 + 卩 (a wild beast pouncing on a kneeling person to commit an offense)
confusable: 狭 (せま・い) and 独 (ひと・り) also use 犭
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day57 verb noun

words:
犯罪[はんざい] — crime — अपराध
罪[つみ] — crime, sin, guilt — पाप, दोष
無罪[むざい] — not guilty — निर्दोष
有罪[ゆうざい] — guilty — दोषी
example: 彼[かれ]は 自分[じぶん]の 罪[つみ]を 認[みと]めた。
example_en: He admitted his guilt.
component: 罒 + 非 (caught in a net for doing wrong)
confusable: 非 (ひ) is the bottom; 買 (か・う) and 置 (お・く) also have 罒 on top
disc_front: Which kanji means 'crime / guilt'? 自分の＿を認めた
disc_note: 罪 = 罒 over 非 — a net over wrongdoing. 非 alone = not (非常). 置 = 罒 over 直 (置く).
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day57 noun confusable

words:
警察[けいさつ] — police — प्रहरी
警官[けいかん] — police officer — प्रहरी अधिकारी
警告[けいこく] — warning — चेतावनी
警備[けいび] — security, guard — सुरक्षा
example: 地震[じしん]の 後[あと]、 津波[つなみ]の 警報[けいほう]が 出[で]た。
example_en: After the earthquake, a tsunami warning was issued.
component: 敬 + 言 (words spoken with vigilant respect to warn and guard)
confusable: 敬 (けい, respect) is the top; 驚 (おどろ・く) = 敬 + 馬
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day57 noun

words:
盗[ぬす]む — to steal — चोर्नु
泥棒[どろぼう]に 盗[ぬす]まれる — to be robbed — चोरी हुनु
盗難[とうなん] — theft — चोरी
example: 自転車[じてんしゃ]を 駅前[えきまえ]で 盗[ぬす]まれた。
example_en: My bicycle was stolen in front of the station.
component: 次 + 皿 (salivating greedily over another's dish to steal it)
confusable: 次 (つぎ) is the top; 温 (おん) and 血 (ち) also involve 皿
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day57 verb

words:
殺[ころ]す — to kill — मार्नु
殺人[さつじん] — murder — हत्या
自殺[じさつ] — suicide — आत्महत्या
忙殺[ぼうさつ]される — to be swamped (with work) — कामले थिचिनु
example: その 小説[しょうせつ]は 殺人[さつじん] 事件[じけん]から 始[はじ]まる。
example_en: That novel begins with a murder case.
example_ne: त्यो उपन्यास हत्याको घटनाबाट सुरु हुन्छ।
component: 杀 + 殳 (striking with a weapon to kill)
confusable: 投 (な・げる) and 段 (だん) also have 殳 on the right
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day57 verb

words:
油[あぶら] — oil — तेल
石油[せきゆ] — petroleum, oil — पेट्रोलियम
醤油[しょうゆ] — soy sauce — सोया सस
油断[ゆだん] — carelessness, letting one's guard down — लापरवाही
example: フライパンに 油[あぶら]を 少[すこ]し 入[い]れてください。
example_en: Please put a little oil in the frying pan.
component: 氵 + 由 (liquid flowing from a sprout or source → oil)
confusable: 由 (ゆう, 理由) is the right half; 届 (とど・く) also has 由
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day58 noun

kunyomi: も・える / も・やす
words:
燃[も]える — to burn (intr.) — बल्नु
燃[も]やす — to burn (tr.) — बाल्नु
燃[も]えるごみ — burnable garbage — जल्ने फोहोर
燃料[ねんりょう] — fuel — इन्धन
example: 燃[も]えるごみは 火曜日[かようび]と 金曜日[きんようび]です。
example_en: Burnable garbage is Tuesday and Friday.
example_ne: जल्ने फोहोर मंगलबार र शुक्रबार हो।
component: 火 + 然 (fire that naturally catches and flares → burn)
confusable: 然 (ぜん) is the right half — 燃 adds 火
disc_front: Which kanji means 'to burn'? ＿えるごみ
disc_note: 燃 has 火 on the left. 然 alone is the suffix in 自然, 全然. 熱 = heat/fever (灬 at the bottom).
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day58 verb confusable

words:
焼[や]く — to grill, bake, burn — पोल्नु
焼[や]ける — to be grilled; to get sunburnt — पाक्नु; पोल्नु
焼[や]き 鳥[とり] — yakitori (grilled chicken) — कुखुराको सेकुवा
日焼[ひや]け — sunburn, suntan — घामले पोलेको
example: 今晩[こんばん]は 魚[さかな]を 焼[や]いて 食[た]べよう。
example_en: Let's grill fish tonight.
component: 火 + 尭 (a towering fire grilling and baking food)
confusable: 暁 (あかつき) = 日 + 尭
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day58 verb

words:
煙[けむり] — smoke — धुवाँ
煙草[たばこ] — cigarette, tobacco — चुरोट
禁煙[きんえん] — no smoking — धूमपान निषेध
煙[けむ]い — smoky — धुवाँले भरिएको
example: この 店[みせ]は 全席[ぜんせき] 禁煙[きんえん]です。
example_en: This place is entirely non-smoking.
example_ne: यो पसल पूरै धूमपान निषेध छ।
component: 火 + 垔 (fire trapped under earth billows up → smoke)
confusable: 火 (ひ) on the left marks it as fire-related, like 燃 and 焼
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day58 noun

kunyomi: こお・る / こご・える
words:
凍[こお]る — to freeze — जम्नु
冷凍[れいとう] — freezing, frozen — फ्रोजन
冷凍食品[れいとうしょくひん] — frozen food — फ्रोजन खाना
凍[こご]える — to be numb with cold — जाडोले काँप्नु
example: 冷凍[れいとう]した ご 飯[はん]を レンジで 温[あたた]めた。
example_en: I warmed the frozen rice in the microwave.
component: 冫 + 東 (ice freezing over the eastern lands)
confusable: 東 (ひがし) is the right half; 冷 (つめ・たい) also has 冫 (the ice radical)
disc_front: Which kanji means 'to freeze'? 冷＿食品
disc_note: 凍 has 冫 (two ice strokes) on the left. 東 alone = east. The 冫 radical marks cold, as in 冷たい.
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day58 verb confusable

words:
煮[に]る — to simmer, boil — उमाल्नु
煮[に]える — to be cooked through — पाक्नु
煮物[にもの] — simmered dish — उमालेको परिकार
煮込[にこ]む — to stew — लामो समय पकाउनु
example: 野菜[やさい]を 弱火[よわび]で ゆっくり 煮[に]る。
example_en: Simmer the vegetables slowly over low heat.
component: 者 + 灬 (someone simmering food over flames)
confusable: 者 (もの) is the top; 熱 and 照 also have 灬 (the fire dots) at the bottom
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day59 verb

words:
蒸[む]す — to steam — बाफमा पकाउनु
蒸[む]し 暑[あつ]い — hot and humid — उमसिलो
蒸気[じょうき] — steam, vapor — बाफ
example: 東京[とうきょう]の 夏[なつ]は 蒸[む]し 暑[あつ]い。
example_en: Tokyo summers are hot and humid.
component: 艹 + 丞 + 灬 (plants heated over fire to produce rising steam)
confusable: 薬 and 若 also have 艹; the 灬 at the bottom marks heat
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day59 verb

words:
塩[しお] — salt — नुन
塩分[えんぶん] — salt content — नुनको मात्रा
塩辛[しおから]い — salty — नुनिलो
塩[しお]を 加[くわ]える — to add salt — नुन थप्नु
example: この スープは 塩[しお]が 足[た]りない。
example_en: This soup needs more salt.
component: 土 + 𠂉 + 口 + 皿 (earthly minerals gathered into a dish → salt)
confusable: 地 (ち) and 均 (きん) also start with 土
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day59 noun

words:
砂[すな] — sand — बालुवा
砂糖[さとう] — sugar — चिनी
砂漠[さばく] — desert — मरुभूमि
砂浜[すなはま] — sandy beach — बालुवाको किनार
example: コーヒーに 砂糖[さとう]を 入[い]れますか。
example_en: Do you take sugar in your coffee?
component: 石 + 少 (stones ground down into few tiny grains → sand)
confusable: 石 (いし) on the left; 研 (けん) and 確 (かく) are also 石 kanji
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day59 noun

words:
粉[こな] — powder, flour — पिठो, धुलो
小麦粉[こむぎこ] — wheat flour — गहुँको पिठो
粉薬[こなぐすり] — powdered medicine — धुलो औषधि
花粉[かふん] — pollen — परागकण
example: 春[はる]は 花粉[かふん]が つらい 季節[きせつ]だ。
example_en: Spring is a rough season for pollen.
example_ne: वसन्त परागकणले गाह्रो हुने मौसम हो।
component: 米 + 分 (rice divided and ground into powder)
confusable: 米 (こめ) on the left marks grain; 料 (りょう) = 米 + 斗
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day59 noun

words:
岩[いわ] — rock — चट्टान
岩石[がんせき] — rock (geological) — शिला
溶岩[ようがん] — lava — लाभा
example: 海[うみ]の 近[ちか]くに 大[おお]きな 岩[いわ]が ある。
example_en: There's a big rock near the sea.
component: 山 + 石 (a mountain made of giant stones → rock)
confusable: 岸 (きし) = 山 + 厂 + 干 — also a 山 kanji
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day60 noun

words:
波[なみ] — wave — छाल
電波[でんぱ] — radio waves, signal — सिग्नल
津波[つなみ] — tsunami — सुनामी
波[なみ]が 高[たか]い — the waves are high — छाल ठूलो छ
example: 今日[きょう]は 波[なみ]が 高[たか]いので 泳[およ]げない。
example_en: The waves are high today so we can't swim.
example_ne: आज छाल ठूलो भएकाले पौडिन सकिँदैन।
component: 氵 + 皮 (water stretching across the surface like skin → wave)
confusable: 皮 (かわ) is the right half; 疲 (つか・れる) = 疒 + 皮; 彼 (かれ) = 彳 + 皮
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day60 noun

words:
湖[みずうみ] — lake — ताल
湖畔[こはん] — lakeside — तालको किनार
富士五湖[ふじごこ] — the Fuji Five Lakes — फुजीका पाँच ताल
example: 山[やま]の 上[うえ]から きれいな 湖[みずうみ]が 見[み]えた。
example_en: We could see a beautiful lake from the mountaintop.
component: 氵 + 古 + 月 (water reflecting the ancient moon → lake)
confusable: 海 (うみ), 波 (なみ), 港 (みなと) — the 氵 water family
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day60 noun

words:
温泉[おんせん] — hot spring — तातोपानी कुण्ड
泉[いずみ] — spring, fountain — पानीको मूल
源泉[げんせん] — source, wellspring — स्रोत
example: 週末[しゅうまつ]に 箱根[はこね]の 温泉[おんせん]に 行[い]った。
example_en: I went to a hot spring in Hakone on the weekend.
component: 白 + 水 (pure white water welling up from the earth → spring)
confusable: 原 (げん) = 厂 + 泉; 線 (せん) = 糸 + 泉
disc_front: Which kanji is in 温泉 (hot spring)? 温＿
disc_note: 泉 = 白 over 水, standing alone. 線 adds 糸 (line). 原 puts 泉 under 厂 (原因).
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day60 noun confusable

words:
港[みなと] — harbor, port — बन्दरगाह
空港[くうこう] — airport — विमानस्थल
港町[みなとまち] — port town — बन्दरगाह सहर
example: 成田空港[なりたくうこう]まで 電車[でんしゃ]で 一時間[いちじかん] かかる。
example_en: It takes an hour by train to Narita Airport.
example_ne: नारिता विमानस्थलसम्म रेलले एक घण्टा लाग्छ।
component: 氵 + 巷 (a water alley where ships gather → harbor)
confusable: 共 (とも) appears inside; 湖, 波 — the 氵 family
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day60 noun

words:
咲[さ]く — to bloom — फुल्नु
花[はな]が 咲[さ]く — flowers bloom — फूल फुल्नु
満開[まんかい]に 咲[さ]く — to be in full bloom — पूर्ण रूपमा फुल्नु
example: 公園[こうえん]の 桜[さくら]が きれいに 咲[さ]いている。
example_en: The cherry blossoms in the park are blooming beautifully.
component: 口 + 关 (a mouth smiling open like a flower in bloom)
confusable: 笑 (わら・う) is historically related; 関 (かん) also contains 关
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day61 verb

words:
枝[えだ] — branch — हाँगा
小枝[こえだ] — twig — सानो हाँगा
枝豆[えだまめ] — edamame — हरियो भटमास
example: 台風[たいふう]で 木[き]の 枝[えだ]が 折[お]れた。
example_en: A tree branch broke in the typhoon.
component: 木 + 支 (a branch branching out to support a tree)
confusable: 支 (ささ・える) is the right half; 技 (わざ) = 扌 + 支
disc_note: 枝 has 木 (tree) on the left. 技 has 扌 — skill (技術). 支 alone = support (支払う).
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day61 noun confusable

words:
葉[は] — leaf — पात
言葉[ことば] — word, language — शब्द, भाषा
紅葉[こうよう] — autumn leaves — शरदका पात
落[お]ち 葉[ば] — fallen leaves — झरेका पात
example: 秋[あき]に なると 葉[は]の 色[いろ]が 変[か]わる。
example_en: When autumn comes the leaves change color.
component: 艹 + 世 + 木 (green leaves growing for generations upon a tree)
confusable: 薬 (くすり) and 若 (わか・い) also have 艹 on top
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day61 noun

words:
根[ね] — root — जरा
根本[こんぽん] — root, fundamental — मूल
屋根[やね] — roof — छाना
大根[だいこん] — daikon radish — मुला
根気[こんき] — perseverance — धैर्य
example: 問題[もんだい]の 根本[こんぽん]から 考[かんが]え 直[なお]そう。
example_en: Let's rethink the problem from its root.
component: 木 + 艮 (a tree firmly rooted and standing its ground)
confusable: 限 (かぎ・る) = 阝 + 艮; 眼 (め) = 目 + 艮; 銀 (ぎん) = 金 + 艮
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day61 noun

words:
農業[のうぎょう] — agriculture — कृषि
農家[のうか] — farmer, farmhouse — किसान
農産物[のうさんぶつ] — agricultural produce — कृषि उपज
農民[のうみん] — farmers, peasantry — किसान
example: 祖父[そふ]は ずっと 農業[のうぎょう]を していた。
example_en: My grandfather farmed all his life.
component: 曲 + 辰 (cultivating bent rows of crops in early farming seasons)
confusable: 豊 (ゆた・か) also has 曲 on top
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day61 noun

words:
資料[しりょう] — materials, data — कागजात, सामग्री
資源[しげん] — resources — स्रोत
投資[とうし] — investment — लगानी
資格[しかく] — qualification — योग्यता
example: 会議[かいぎ]の 資料[しりょう]を 印刷[いんさつ]しておいた。
example_en: I printed the materials for the meeting.
component: 次 + 貝 (the next batch of money used as capital resources)
confusable: 盗 (ぬす・む) = 次 + 皿 — same top, different bottom
disc_front: Which kanji is in 資料 (materials)? ＿料
disc_note: 資 has 貝 (money/value) at the bottom. 盗 has 皿 — to steal. 姿 has 女 — figure, appearance (姿勢).
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day62 noun confusable

words:
資源[しげん] — resources — स्रोत
電源[でんげん] — power source, power switch — पावर स्रोत
源[みなもと] — source, origin — मूल स्रोत
水源[すいげん] — water source — पानीको स्रोत
example: パソコンの 電源[でんげん]を 切[き]るのを 忘[わす]れた。
example_en: I forgot to turn off the computer's power.
component: 氵 + 原 (water springing from its original meadow source)
confusable: 原 (げん, 原因) is the right half — 源 adds 氵
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day62 noun

words:
素材[そざい] — material — सामग्री
要素[ようそ] — element, factor — तत्त्व
素直[すなお] — obedient, frank — सोझो
素晴[すば]らしい — wonderful — अद्भुत
example: この 料理[りょうり]は 素材[そざい]の 味[あじ]が よく 分[わ]かる。
example_en: In this dish you can really taste the ingredients themselves.
example_ne: यो परिकारमा सामग्रीकै स्वाद राम्ररी थाहा हुन्छ।
component: 龶 + 糸 (raw silk thread kept plain and unadorned)
confusable: 系 (けい) and 紀 (き) also involve 糸
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day62 noun

words:
質問[しつもん] — question — प्रश्न
品質[ひんしつ] — quality — गुणस्तर
性質[せいしつ] — nature, disposition — स्वभाव
質[しつ]が いい — good quality — राम्रो गुणस्तर
example: 何[なに]か 質問[しつもん]が ありますか。
example_en: Do you have any questions?
component: 斦 + 貝 (weighing two axes against money to judge their quality)
confusable: 資 (し), 貧 (ひん), 費 (ひ) — the 貝 family
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day62 noun

words:
例[れい] — example — उदाहरण
例[たと]えば — for example — उदाहरणका लागि
例外[れいがい] — exception — अपवाद
実例[じつれい] — concrete example — वास्तविक उदाहरण
example: 例[たと]えば、 この 表現[ひょうげん]は 手紙[てがみ]では 使[つか]いません。
example_en: For example, this expression isn't used in letters.
example_ne: उदाहरणका लागि, यो अभिव्यक्ति चिठीमा प्रयोग हुँदैन।
component: 亻 + 列 (a person standing in line as a clear example)
confusable: 列 (れつ, row) is the right half; 烈 (れつ) = 列 + 灬
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day62 noun

words:
案内[あんない] — guidance, showing around — मार्गदर्शन
提案[ていあん] — proposal — प्रस्ताव
案[あん] — plan, idea — योजना
心配[しんぱい]する — see also 案[あん]じる (to worry) — चिन्ता गर्नु
example: 駅[えき]で 道[みち]を 案内[あんない]してもらった。
example_en: Someone showed me the way at the station.
component: 宀 + 女 + 木 (a relaxed woman sitting at a wooden desk working on a plan)
confusable: 安 (やす・い) = 宀 + 女 — 案 is 安 with 木 underneath
disc_front: Which kanji is in 案内 (guidance)? ＿内
disc_note: 案 has 木 under 安. 安 alone = cheap, safe (安い). 宮 = palace (宮殿).
tags: N3 kanji batch8 vocab_linked kanji_day63 noun confusable

words:
件[けん] — matter, case — विषय
事件[じけん] — incident, case — घटना
条件[じょうけん] — condition, terms — सर्त
用件[ようけん] — business, matter to discuss — काम
